objective: Prepare fixed schemas and source interfaces for the approved symbolic GOE ruler; do not perform the audit in this queue.

tasks.title: Implement GOE ruler preparation without measurements

handoff.objective: Prepare the ten source/schema artifacts implementing the complete GOE ruler successor, without generating fixtures or running scientific work.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Can the frozen instrument, exact independent-check interfaces, fixture certification and three-process admission guards be implemented without hiding costs or weakening physical-host requirements?
constraints: You are not alone. Own only the ten declared files; preserve other work and all original immutable records.
Start only after the canonical design, decision and this handoff are committed and archived, with a genuine valid task claim and policy resolution.

Maximum runs is zero. Do not generate realized curves, scalar/primitive input fixtures, measurement tables, rho walks, proof certificates or scientific test results. Preparation includes source and unfilled schemas/templates only.
Preserve every scientific formula, input count, seed, threshold, host requirement, 40-job scope, three-process rho schedule and nine-row model scope. No scalar-GOE substitution for a rho step.

Implement point/field producer source separately from affine checker and count predictor. Document authorship and read boundaries honestly; a shared author or source dependency is not independent review. An actual separately authored/re-derived checker and count report remain scientific admission prerequisites.

Implement guards and fixture-certificate interfaces prospectively; do not claim available physical host B, boot IDs, a delegated cgroup, image digests, source hashes, measured resources or successful preflight values that have not been observed.

Source-only static inspection may assess interfaces; do not execute generated scientific code, proof checks, fixtures, timing tests or benchmark self-tests in this task. Any later validation launch requires its own bounded authorization and actual receipt.

Do not edit shared launch tools. Implement the required exclusive outputs, cgroup readback, bounded worker tree, durable checkpoints and catchable-failure receipts within the owned driver interface; unavailable guards must refuse scientific admission.
Missing source/API or independent-author capability is reported as a concrete implementation limitation. Do not silently replace algorithms, fabricate independence or mark a stub measurement-ready.
Record the actual model identifier only if exposed, with verification status. No fallback, degradation or Bedrock.

This preparation handoff never authorizes any of the 40 scientific jobs. Later execution needs independently reviewed executable/checker, realized certificates, physical-host admission, an exact locked plan, genuine execution claim, and archive ownership.

artifact_contract.driver.py: Single coordinator/runner entry, exact jobs/cells, three-process barriers, timers, cgroup admission, resource accounting, exclusive output and checkpoint interfaces; no fixture or benchmark execution at import.
artifact_contract.arithmetic.py: Frozen field API, EFD co-Z rescaling/addition/doubling, normalization, scalar routine and planted variant; preserve separate non-field counters.
artifact_contract.independent_checker.py: Separate affine verification and certificate-check interface, source-dependency restrictions and explicit soundness limits; independently authored/reviewed status is recorded rather than inferred from its filename.
artifact_contract.count_predictor.py: Formula/branch recurrence interface from the frozen specification, separate from producer traces, with commitment/blinding interface. No predicted numerical fixture counts are evaluated now.
artifact_contract.fixture_generator.py: Deterministic seed serialization, prime/order-certificate and reduced curve construction source; no realized fixture bytes or certificates.
artifact_contract.rho.py: Two actual worker processes, coefficient-tracked branches, common partition/DP law, canonical endpoint table, restart and IPC/checkpoint accounting.
artifact_contract.schemas.json: Inputs, source/admission hashes, field counts, blind reports, fixtures/certificates, each job artifact, summary/model rows, checkpoints and incomplete/failure outcomes. Structural validation alone does not prove arithmetic, independence or scientific validity.
artifact_contract.admission-template.json: All required actual-value fields null/unverified with blocking reasons; distinguish two physical hosts from three guest environments. No invented boot/image/cgroup/measurement data.
artifact_contract.implementation-manifest.yaml: Exact prepared source/dependency hashes, author/access provenance, runtime requirements and unresolved review dependencies; no launch or measured run claim.
artifact_contract.preparation-report.yaml: Requirement-by-requirement mapping, static work actually performed, source limitations, checker independence status, no-run attestation and exact next admission tasks.

completion_gate: All ten files exist, parse as appropriate under parent-controlled validation, and bind the exact canonical contract; no scientific fixture or measurement was executed.
Source implements the frozen interfaces or reports exact remaining technical defects without claiming measurement readiness; no silent weakening of counts, formulas, host requirements or guards.
Authorship/access boundaries and remaining independent review requirements are explicit; all unavailable admission fields remain unverified.
Parent-controlled archive binds exact bytes and implementation limitations before a later scientific plan is considered.
